entity.summary: Self-custodial XRP Ledger wallet formerly branded Xumm and rebranded to Xaman in 2023.
entity.notes: First-party Xaman material explicitly preserves Xumm→Xaman continuity and describes Xaman as self-custodial. Initial Xumm launch date remains unresolved in this breadth pass.

products.summary: Current Xaman self-custodial XRP Ledger mobile wallet, continuing the former Xumm application lineage.
products.notes: The 2023 Xumm→Xaman transition is a rebrand, not an initial mobile-product launch date. Current first-party help links official App Store and Google Play versions.

events.title: XUMM announced its rebrand to Xaman
events.description: The XUMM wallet team announced the Xaman brand and a gradual transition while preserving the existing wallet functionality and operational lineage.
events.notes: The rebrand announcement does not reset the wallet/product launch chronology.

evidence.title: Xumm Evolves into a New Era: Welcome, Xaman!
evidence.notes: First-party announcement establishes Xumm→Xaman rebrand continuity and states previously XRPL Labs/Xumm product functionality remains continuous.

evidence.title: What is Xaman?
evidence.notes: Current first-party help center identifies Xaman formerly Xumm as a self-custodial XRP Ledger wallet with keys kept on the user's device.

evidence.title: XUMM evolves into a new era: Welcome Xaman
evidence.notes: First-party Xaman announcement explicitly introduces the XUMM-to-Xaman rebrand and describes a gradual transition without a new wallet lineage.

evidence.title: Official communication channels
evidence.notes: Current first-party Xaman help documentation links the latest Apple App Store and Google Play versions and the in-app support channel, supporting active maintenance of Xaman Mobile.
